description: Retain caller-directed unequal rectangle regions with stable identities and atomic single cuts/removals.

provenance.relationship: Capability-dependency admission motivated by retained supplied rectangle edits; corrected source selection/ratios/omission behavior remains outside this independently specified stateful operation.

bounds.description: [left,top,right,bottom] finite binary64 bounds with positive width and height.

output_invariants: nextId is the next never-reused leaf identity; leaves are live immutable regions in stable order, with canonical finite bounds. Commands are applied sequentially to one owned model per case; failed commands expose no output mutation and consume no identity.

behavior.creation: Exactly {bounds:[left,top,right,bottom]}; finite binary64 coordinates, left<right and top<bottom, separately finite rounded extents; normalize negative zero. Root leaf has id0 and nextId1.
behavior.commands: Typed command narrative: cut(long id,String axis,double coordinate) returns fresh long[2] allocated IDs; remove(long id) returns void. Axis is exactly X or Y. Each successful cut appends low-coordinate then high-coordinate children after removing the parent; remove deletes only the selected live leaf. Each command validates fully before mutation.
behavior.validation: Creation accepts exact Map key bounds and exactly four supported numeric List values; command precedence and errors follow the normative contract. No Object command adapters are part of the portable interchange fixture; native tests use typed commands.
behavior.ownership: Live leaves are owned immutable values. leaf returns an immutable live value; leaves returns a detached membership list; toValues returns detached mutable values; caller inputs and prior returned containers cannot mutate the model. Removed IDs are never reused.
behavior.identity: Root id0, nextId1; each successful cut allocates two IDs and increments nextId by2. 9007199254740991 is exhausted nextId sentinel, never a leaf ID.
behavior.complexity: Expected O(1) lookup/cut/removal with ordered identity storage; O(live count) detached snapshot materialization. Representation limits are not workload recommendations.
behavior.java_surface: org.procedurals.layout.RetainedRectangles2D: create(Object), create(double,double,double,double), cut(long,String,double), remove(long), leaf(long), leaves(), size(), toValues(); nested immutable Leaf and EditException.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Malformed creation/configuration, unsupported carrier, nonfinite coordinate, invalid bounds, axis, or nonfinite cut.
errors.UNKNOWN_ID: Valid-domain ID is not currently live.
errors.INVALID_CUT: Finite cut is not strictly inside the selected live bound.
errors.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Live-count or identity capacity limit would be exceeded.

bounds.evidence: CP21 retained supplied-region boundary; finite positive extents and identity limits are representational, not artistic ranges.

reproduction.acceptance: Native retained-cuts workflow must demonstrate selected cuts, independent decoration, removal, reset and cached save; no original recreation claim.

review.status: Root reviewed contract/schema and analytic fixtures frozen for Java implementation; no runtime support accepted.
